config.title: Global settings
config.feishuHint: Account-level URL overrides this global value
config.dingtalkSecretGlobalHint: If the global bot uses signing, enter the paired SEC; leave empty if unsigned. Account webhooks still use account-level secrets when set.
config.telegramChatIdHint: Target chat ID (groups may be negative)
config.quotaBudgetHint: When no account or default API key is set, this caps daily usage. Per-key daily_quota takes precedence. Units match Google Cloud quota units.
config.timezoneHint: Only affects daily aggregation boundaries; historical rows keep prior date_key.
config.channelMetaTTLHint: After this many days, channel metadata is refreshed. 0 means never expire.
config.notifyOnScanErrorHint: At most one alert per account within the cooldown window.
config.scanJitterHint: Random 0–N second delay per scan to avoid thundering herd. 0 disables.
config.quotaAlertThresholdsHint: Comma-separated, e.g. 80,90,100; one alert per threshold per day.
config.channelMetaHealthEnable: Enabled (uses channels.list on cache hit, ~1 unit each)
config.notifyChannelMetaMismatch: Alert global Webhook on mismatch (Feishu → DingTalk → Telegram)
config.noDefaultKey: — No default key (must specify per account) —
config.defaultApiKeyHint: Used when an account has no key. Add more keys under API Keys.
config.cookiesFileHint: Netscape (.txt) or JSON (.json). Leave empty to disable. Export with e.g. “Get cookies.txt LOCALLY”.
config.enableAria2Hint: When on, downloads use aria2c with 16 connections. Install aria2 and ensure it is on PATH.
config.subLangsHint: Comma-separated languages when subtitles are enabled. Official subtitles may require cookies.
config.llmCategoryHint: Affects topic detection and scoring weights
config.dynProxyEnableDesc: When account fixed proxy is unavailable, try dynamic routes automatically.
config.dynProxyNewAccount: New accounts inherit system dynamic proxy
config.dynProxyNewAccountDesc: If no fixed proxy is bound, routing follows system policy.
config.dynProxyExistingAccount: Apply system fallback to existing accounts
config.dynProxyExistingAccountWarn: Warning: changes behavior for existing accounts.
config.riskFreeProxyManual: Allow free proxies for manual downloads
config.riskFreeProxyAuto: Allow free proxies for auto downloads
config.riskCookieNoFreeProxy: No free proxies for cookie downloads
config.riskCookieNoFreeProxyDesc: Cookie downloads avoid free public proxies by default.
config.riskManualDirectFallback: Allow direct fallback for manual downloads
config.riskAutoDirectFallback: Allow direct fallback for auto downloads
config.riskAutoDirectFallbackWarn: Warning: auto downloads normally disallow direct.
config.maskProxyLogsDesc: Hide specific egress IP/port in logs
config.dynProviderManageDesc: Add, edit, and test paid/free providers

dynProviders.title: Dynamic proxy providers
dynProviders.emptyDesc: After adding a provider, it participates in system dynamic proxy routing. Paid routes first, free as fallback.
dynProviders.addFirstNote: Providers are tried from lowest to highest priority
dynProviders.workbenchDesc: Manages list-pull providers only (refresh / cleanup / run-once); does not affect account scans. The Provider Scheduler does not start automatically — click “Start Dynamic Proxy Scheduler”.
dynProviders.execHint: Separate from monitor_events · expand to filter
dynProviders.localProxyUrlHint: Address of a local proxy (Clash, v2ray, etc.)
dynProviders.listAdapterHint: Pick Geonode for official Geonode APIs; otherwise leave adapter blank and set paths.
dynProviders.supportsStickyDesc: Keep the same IP for a while (recommended)
